马六甲苏丹国与港口管理 · 15世纪；原图谱案例约1400–1511

皇家关税局的历史刊物记载，Syahbandar按商人群体分工，处理市场与仓储、度量衡、船舶出入和税务。可据此阅读港务制度；它不提供每年、每种货物或每笔交易的完整税率账簿。

Malacca Sultanate and port administration · 15th century; Atlas context approximately 1400–1511

The Customs Department’s historical publication describes Syahbandar assigned to merchant groups, with duties covering markets, warehouses, measures, ship movements and taxation. It supports a port-administration account, not a complete annual tariff or individual transaction ledger.
